name: Practice Better
description: Practice Better is practice-management and electronic health record software for health and wellness professionals. Practices use it for clients, bookings, clinical notes, forms, programs, billing, measurements, protocols, labs, insurance, telehealth, and daily administration.
agentUseSummary: Add the client ID and client secret from your approved Practice Better API add-on, then choose which agents can use the complete current beta API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: PRACTICE_BETTER_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Practice Better client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create an API key after Practice Better approves the API Access beta add-on, then copy its client ID.

credentialRequirements.name: PRACTICE_BETTER_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Practice Better client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the client secret shown when the API key is created. This is not the user's Practice Better password.

capabilities.label: Read practice and clinical data
capabilities.description: Read clients, schedules, programs, forms, clinical records, measurements, protocols, labs, billing, insurance, tasks, tags, webhooks, and account settings through every documented retrieval operation.

capabilities.label: Manage practice and clinical data
capabilities.description: Create, update, cancel, enroll, reschedule, and delete supported records through every documented mutation in the current beta API.

allowed.label: Read Practice Better
allowed.description: Run one bounded operation from the complete documented retrieval and reporting surface.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Practice Better
approvalRequired.description: Run one documented mutation for practice, client, clinical, scheduling, billing, program, tag, or webhook data.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: The customer-owned client secret and short-lived access tokens never enter agent-visible requests or results.

blocked.label: Use another API origin
blocked.description: Every token and business request stays on Practice Better's documented fixed HTTPS API origin.

blocked.label: Call another endpoint
blocked.description: Relay permits only the 92 current documented beta operations represented by the read and manage tools.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds query fields, request bodies, responses, redirects, nesting, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Retrieval and reporting operations run directly. Every operation that creates, changes, cancels, enrolls, reschedules, or deletes data requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every documented operation authorized by the connected practice runs without Relay per-action approval. Practice authority, API-key restrictions, exact routes, bounds, credential protection, provider limits, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway exchanges encrypted customer-owned credentials server-side and mounts all 92 current beta API operations through fixed-origin bounded tools.
Railway exchanges encrypted customer-owned credentials server-side and mounts all 92 current beta API operations through fixed-origin bounded tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Practice Better's API is a paid-plan beta add-on that requires the account owner to accept the API terms and pass a support-team review before customer-owned client credentials can be created. No approved practice credentials or authorized clinical test account are available for production verification.
providerSetup.nextAction: A paid Practice Better account owner must request the API Access beta add-on, complete provider review, create a restricted API key, and connect its client ID and secret. Then verify token exchange, representative reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutations, redaction, credential replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Practice Better documents the paid-plan API add-on, support review, customer-created client ID and secret, short-lived client-credentials token exchange, and current beta status.

Practice Better's official Swagger 2.0 definition documents the fixed api.practicebetter.io origin, read and write scopes, five-request-per-second and 10,000-request-per-day limits, and 92 current business operations.
Practice Better's API terms make the subscribing customer responsible for API fees, credentials, privacy, API-client security, and provider-enforced limits.
